title: UrDeck theme
description: theme.json. Everything is optional and merges over default-dark. Unknown keys are allowed (the deck ignores a key it does not read and says so). Sizes are fractions of one grid cell unless a unit is stated.

angle.description: Degrees, 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom.

glow.description: A soft glow. color omitted = the thing's own colour.

blur.description: Blur radius, fraction of a cell.

color.description: The glow's colour. Default: the colour of the thing it glows round.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, for editor completion. Ignored.

meta.description: Descriptive data for an editor. It never affects what the deck draws.

description.description: A sentence about the theme, for an editor's list.

license.description: The licence of the theme's files, for example `MIT` or `CC-BY-4.0`.

version.description: The theme's own version, as text.

mode.description: Lets the editor group themes and pick a matching default.

tags.description: Words that help find the theme, such as `dark` or `mono`.

pairsWith.description: Recommendations for a settings editor. They never decide what the deck shows.

backgrounds.description: Names of the backgrounds that suit this theme, best first. Built-in or yours; a name that does not exist is skipped. The theme's default background belongs in this list.

file.description: A picture of the theme: a file inside the theme folder.

caption.description: Text to show with the picture.

samples.description: Same shape as a background manifest's samples.

background.description: The colour behind everything, and the colour a translucent card is blended over.

cardFill.description: The fill of a card. An alpha makes it translucent.

cardBorder.description: The colour of a card's border (see `card.borderWidth`).

text.description: The colour of values and text.

textMuted.description: The colour of labels and units, and of a reading that is not current.

accent.description: The colour of a gauge's fill and of highlights.

accentDim.description: Its alpha sets the opacity of a gauge's track, which is drawn in the gauge's own colour.

good.description: The colour of a healthy level: the first step of the default ramp and the `OK` chip.

warning.description: A gauge's colour once its reading reaches the warning level.

critical.description: A gauge's colour once its reading reaches the critical level.

backgroundPalette.description: One to four `#RRGGBB` colours the built-in background shaders draw with; fewer than four repeat the last. Without it the palette is made from `colors.background` mixed towards `colors.accent`.

accent2.description: A second accent for gradients, markers, redlines and highlights. Default: the accent.

ramp.description: Two to five colours from low to high load. Default: good, warning, critical. Used when `gauge.colorBy` is `ramp`, and by `icons.tint` `ramp`.

cardTints.description: One to eight fill colours the cards cycle through when `card.tint` is `cycle`.

ink.description: The text colour on top of an accent or tint fill. Default: whichever of the text and background colours contrasts more with the fill.

card.description: The card each widget sits on: its shape, fill, border, light and shadow.

radius.description: Corner radius, a fraction of a cell, limited to half the card's smaller side. 0 gives flat tiles.

borderWidth.description: Border width, a fraction of a cell. 0 draws no border.

gap.description: The space between neighbouring cards, a fraction of a cell.

padding.description: The space between a card's edge and its content, a fraction of a cell.

shape.description: `round` is the rounded rectangle of `radius`; `chamfer` cuts the corners named in `cutCorners` with a straight line (Ember).

cut.description: Chamfer size, a fraction of a cell, limited to half the card's smaller side.

cutCorners.description: The corners a chamfer cuts: `tl`, `tr`, `br`, `bl`. An empty list gives square cards.

borderDash.description: The dashes of a `dashed` border. Absent: a dash of three border widths and a gap of two. A dash is centred on every corner.

on.description: Length of a dash, a fraction of a cell.

off.description: Length of a gap, a fraction of a cell.

borderGradient.description: Colours the border with a gradient, solid or dashed (Rigline, Ember).

kind.description: `linear` runs across the card at `angle`; `conic` goes once round the card from the right, which is what lets it spin.

angle.description: Direction of a linear gradient in degrees: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom.

borderAnimate.description: Moves the border. It moves only at the motion level `full`, and never on a dashed border or one without a width.

mode.description: `spin` turns a conic `borderGradient` once round the card; `pulse` breathes the border's opacity; `none` leaves it still.

cornerMarks.description: Registration marks at the corners, on the card or outside it (Carbon, Blueprint).

style.description: `bracket` draws an L at each corner, `tick` one arm along the top or bottom edge, `none` draws no marks.

corners.description: The corners that get a mark: `tl`, `tr`, `br`, `bl`. Default: `tl` and `br`.

size.description: Length of each arm, a fraction of a cell.

thickness.description: Line width, a fraction of a cell.

inset.description: Distance from the card's edge to the mark's outer edge, a fraction of a cell. Negative puts the mark outside the card.

color.description: The marks' colour. Default: the accent.

shadow.description: A drop shadow under each card, soft or a hard offset. It is drawn under all the cards, never over a neighbour.

x.description: Horizontal offset, a fraction of a cell.

y.description: Vertical offset, a fraction of a cell.

blur.description: Blur, a fraction of a cell. 0 or absent gives a hard edge (Pop).

spread.description: How far the shadow grows beyond the card on every side, a fraction of a cell. Negative shrinks it.

color.description: The shadow's colour. Default: black at 40 % opacity.

glow.description: A glow round each card, blurred outwards from its shape (Rigline). Without `blur` it draws nothing.

highlight.description: A line of light just inside the top or bottom edge of the card (Prism).

top.description: Colour of the specular line along the top edge.

bottom.description: Colour of the rim light along the bottom edge, inside the card.

thickness.description: Line width, a fraction of a cell.

sheen.description: A radial patch of light inside the card, over the fill and under the content (Prism).

color.description: The light's colour, fading to transparent at its edge. Without it there is no sheen.

accentStrip.description: A lit line along one edge of every card, inside it (Carbon's scan line, Rigline's tile strips).

side.description: The edge the strip runs along: `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`.

thickness.description: Line width, a fraction of a cell.

length.description: Length of the strip as a fraction of the side it runs along. It is centred on the side.

colors.description: Strip colours, one to eight, cycled card by card (and slot by slot in the dock). Default: the accent.

fade.description: Fades the strip to transparent along its length (Carbon's scan line).

glow.description: A blurred copy of the strip laid under it, inside the card. A glow without `blur` draws nothing.

tint.description: `cycle` fills the cards from `colors.cardTints` in page order, row by row; `none` uses the card fill.

compact.description: Overrides for small cards: the dock's slots and page cards of one grid cell. A value left out is the page card's.

radius.description: Corner radius of a compact card, a fraction of a cell, in place of `card.radius`.

borderWidth.description: Border width of a compact card, a fraction of a cell, in place of `card.borderWidth`.

shape.description: `round`, `chamfer`, or `circle`, which makes a square card a circle (Obsidian's dock).

accentStrip.description: A lit strip for compact cards (Rigline's tiles), merged over `card.accentStrip` key by key.

side.description: The edge the strip runs along: `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`.

thickness.description: Line width, a fraction of a cell.

length.description: Length of the strip as a fraction of the side it runs along. It is centred on the side.

colors.description: Strip colours, one to eight, cycled slot by slot. Default: the accent.

glow.description: A blurred copy of the strip laid under it, inside the card. A glow without `blur` draws nothing.

cornerMarks.description: Registration marks for compact cards, merged over `card.cornerMarks` key by key.

style.description: `bracket` draws an L at each corner, `tick` one arm along the top or bottom edge, `none` draws no marks.

corners.description: The corners that get a mark: `tl`, `tr`, `br`, `bl`. Default: `tl` and `br`.

size.description: Length of each arm, a fraction of a cell.

thickness.description: Line width, a fraction of a cell.

inset.description: Distance from the card's edge to the mark's outer edge, a fraction of a cell. Negative puts the mark outside the card.

color.description: The marks' colour. Default: the accent.

pattern.description: One texture over the whole window, above the background and under the cards. It does not slide with the pages.

spacing.description: Distance between marks, a fraction of a cell.

majorEvery.description: Every Nth line of a `grid` is drawn heavier (Blueprint: 5).

thickness.description: Line width, or a dot's radius, a fraction of a cell.

color.description: The marks' colour. Default: the muted text colour at a sixteenth of its opacity.

major.description: The look of a grid's heavier lines.

color.description: Colour of the heavier lines. Default: the pattern's own.

thickness.description: Width of the heavier lines, a fraction of a cell. Default: the pattern's own.

angle.description: Direction of a `hatch` in degrees from horizontal, rising to the right.

divider.description: The rule widgets draw between their sections, such as the weather card's between now and the forecast.

style.description: `line`, `gradient`, `dimension` (a line with end ticks and an optional centred label, Blueprint) or `none`.

color.description: The rule's colour. Default: the muted text colour at about a third of its opacity.

thickness.description: Line width, a fraction of a cell.

gradientTo.description: The colour a `gradient` rule fades to.

well.description: A recessed rounded rectangle behind grouped content, such as each forecast day of the weather card (Rigline). Absent: no well.

radius.description: Corner radius, a fraction of a cell.

chip.description: A pill round short text: a gauge's status word (`OK`, `WARM`) and the weather card's condition.

shape.description: `pill` draws a pill round the text and shrinks it with the text; `none` draws only the text.

textColor.description: The colour of the text inside the pill.

colorBy.description: `status` tints a gauge's status chip by its level (good, warning, critical); `none` keeps the chip's own colours.

typography.description: Fonts, weights, sizes and the look of values and labels.

font.description: The default font for every role: an installed family, or the name of a `.ttf` or `.otf` file in the theme folder.

fonts.description: A font per role. A role without one uses `typography.font`.

value.description: Font of readout values: a family or a file in the theme folder.

unit.description: Font of readout units: a family or a file in the theme folder.

label.description: Font of readout labels: a family or a file in the theme folder.

weights.description: Font weight per role. A variable font takes it through its weight axis; a static font is used as it is.

labelSize.description: Size of labels, a fraction of a cell.

bodySize.description: Size of body text, a fraction of a cell.

titleSize.description: Size of titles, a fraction of a cell.

unitRatio.description: The size of a readout's unit as a fraction of its value's size.

valueScale.description: Multiplies the size a widget asks of a readout, never beyond the size at which value, unit and label fill their rectangle (Pop and Obsidian run big).

case.description: Letter case applied when text is drawn.

label.description: Case of readout labels and of text lines at the label step: `none`, `upper` or `lower`.

title.description: Case of text lines at the title step: `none`, `upper` or `lower`.

tracking.description: Letter spacing in em, added after each character but the last. Equal-width digits stay equal.

value.description: Spacing of readout values, in em.

label.description: Spacing of readout labels and label lines, in em.

title.description: Spacing of title lines, in em.

opticalSize.description: `off` leaves a font's optical size axis (`opsz`) where the font puts it; `auto` sets it for each role: the top of the axis for values and units, the role's pixel size for labels, body and titles. A font without the axis is unaffected.

slant.description: Leans a readout's value to the right, in degrees. Prefer a real italic file when the family has one.

valueFill.description: Fills the value text with a gradient (Rigline's clock).

colors.description: Gradient stops, two to six, evenly spaced.

angle.description: Direction in degrees: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom.

valueGlow.description: A blurred copy behind the value text.

stroke.description: How components that draw lines draw them.

thickness.description: Line thickness as a fraction of the drawn element.

cap.description: The ends of a line: `round` or `square`.

gauge.description: The shape of a gauge and the parts it can have.

style.description: The shape a gauge takes when a widget asks for the theme's: `ring`, `bar`, `verticalBar`, `meter` (a thin bar with ticks and a scale), `tach` (an arc with ticks, a redline and a needle), `marker` (a hairline ring or bar with a jewel) or `thickbar` (a heavy outlined bar). A widget's own style wins.

labelPosition.description: Where a gauge's label sits. `auto` keeps the default placement (Prism: below).

layout.description: `stacked` draws a bar with the readout above, left-aligned, and the track at the bottom (Carbon). A meter and a thick bar are stacked by definition; `auto` keeps the bar's own layout.

readoutGap.description: The space between a bar's, meter's or thick bar's track and its readout, in thicknesses of the track.

sweep.description: The arc a ring, tach or marker gauge covers.

start.description: Where the arc starts, in degrees: 0 is 3 o'clock, clockwise. The default ring starts at 135.

span.description: How many degrees the arc covers. The default ring covers 270.

segments.description: Chops the fill, and the track, into LED-style blocks.

length.description: Length of a segment: along a bar, a fraction of a cell; round a ring, the arc length in cells.

gap.description: The space between segments, in the same unit as the length.

outline.description: An outline round the track (the thick bar).

width.description: Outline width, a fraction of a cell.

ticks.description: Tick marks on rings, tachs and meters.

count.description: How many ticks. A tach with no ticks group has 28; a ticks group that leaves this out has 11.

length.description: Tick length, a fraction of a cell.

thickness.description: Tick width, a fraction of a cell.

labels.description: Prints a number at each major tick, from 0 to 100.
Two to eleven labels printed under a bar at even spacing, for example `["0", "50", "100"]`.

size.description: Size of the labels, a fraction of a cell.

redline.description: A zone at the top of the scale drawn in its own colour (Ember). A tach has one from 0.85 even when the theme sets none.

from.description: Where the zone starts, as a fraction of the scale.

glow.description: A soft glow on the zone.

lightsAbove.description: The zone lights only while the value is inside it (Ember).

gradient.description: `"ramp"` fills along `colors.ramp`; or give a gradient's own stops.

glow.description: A glow round the fill. Default colour: the fill's.

marker.description: A marker at the value (Obsidian's jewel, Blueprint's needle).

size.description: Marker size, a fraction of a cell.

halo.description: Draws a dark ring round the marker.

crosshair.description: Draws a cross at the centre of dials (Blueprint).

track.description: Overrides the default track, which is the fill's colour at the alpha of `colors.accentDim`.

colorBy.description: `ramp` colours the fill by its value along `colors.ramp` instead of the accent, warning and critical steps.

valueTint.description: Colours the readout with the same colour as the fill.

sparkline.description: A history line under the readout, in the fill's colour. Stats keeps the history, one value a second, and draws the line when the card is at least 0.9 of a cell tall.

height.description: Height of the line, a fraction of a cell.

historySeconds.description: How many seconds of history the line shows.

strokeWidth.description: Line width, a fraction of a cell.

status.description: A status chip on the label's row. Stats chooses the word from the gauge's fraction and the thresholds, or from a slot's own warning and critical levels.

thresholds.description: Where the status turns warm and hot, as fractions from 0 to 1. Default: 0.7 and 0.9.

labels.description: The three words, for a healthy, a warm and a hot reading.

indicator.description: The page indicator: one dot per page, the current one a pill.

bandHeight.description: Height of the band reserved at the bottom of the screen, fraction of a cell.

pillLength.description: Length of the current page's pill.

active.description: Colour of the current page's mark.

backdrop.description: Colour of the translucent pill behind a floating indicator.

press.description: How a card looks while a finger is down on a widget that accepts taps (a shortcut).

scale.description: The pressed card's size; 1 leaves it unchanged.

opacity.description: The pressed card's opacity; 1 leaves it unchanged.

dock.description: The dock at the bottom of the screen.

height.description: Height of the dock's band, which is also the side of a dock slot, fraction of a cell.

icons.description: The icon set the weather and shortcut cards draw their glyphs from.

set.description: Name of an icon set: a folder `icons/<set>/` inside the theme folder (with a `manifest.json`), or a built-in set (`outline`). A key the set lacks is answered by `outline`.

stroke.description: Line width of the set's icons, a fraction of the icon's size.

tint.description: `accent`, `accent2`, `text`, `ramp` (the colour of `colors.ramp` that suits the value shown, such as the temperature), `none` (the text colour) or a `#colour`.

glow.description: A glow behind the set's icons (Rigline). Its colour defaults to the icon's tint.

background.description: What the deck shows behind the cards when the configuration has no `background` of its own.

default.description: The moving background this theme selects.

name.description: A shader background's name: built in, or a folder in `backgrounds/`. It draws with the theme's palette.

static.description: A still background, used when there is no default or when the default cannot be shown: an image, a gradient or a colour, the first that is given. It is drawn once.

image.description: A file in the theme folder, scaled to cover the deck. A path that leaves the folder is ignored.

colors.description: The stops, two to six, evenly spaced.

angle.description: Direction of a linear gradient in degrees: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom.

cx.description: Centre of a radial gradient across the deck, as a fraction of its width.

cy.description: Centre of a radial gradient down the deck, as a fraction of its height.

radius.description: Radius of a radial gradient, as a fraction of the deck's width.

scrim.description: A veil between the background and the cards that holds text contrast. It is drawn over a shader, a picture and a still background, not over the plain colour.

color.description: The veil's colour. Its own alpha multiplies `alpha`.

alpha.description: The veil's opacity. Without both a colour and an alpha there is no scrim.

motion.description: How much the theme may move.

level.description: The ceiling for the theme's own animation (`card.borderAnimate`). The level that applies is the lower of this and the user's: the configuration's `motion`, or Windows' animation setting. It does not touch a moving background, which follows the user's level alone.
